# lemma.id: relying-site integration pointers for AI agents

lemma.id is **Sign in with lemma.id**: passwordless login with passkeys and a
site-private, stable `ppid` as the account key. No usernames, passwords, or
email collection; your backend verifies a signed presentation locally.
**isHuman** is an optional step-up assurance tier (one verified human per
account) on the same PPID — request it per action, it is not a separate
integration.

## Start here

- Sign-in quickstart: https://lemma.id/docs/integration/QUICK_START_SIMPLE_LOGIN.md
- Full sign-in guide (sessions, linking, sign-out): https://lemma.id/docs/integration/SIMPLE_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md
- Canonical integration contract (machine-oriented, authoritative): https://lemma.id/docs/integration/ISHUMAN_AGENT_INTEGRATION.md
- Browser support + SDK error codes: https://lemma.id/docs/integration/BROWSER_SUPPORT.md
- Human-readable docs: https://lemma.id/docs
- Repo agent entrypoint (if working in the lemma-enterprise repo): AGENTS.md

## Sign in (default integration)

Drop-in button:

```html
<script src="https://lemma.id/sdk/proof-verifier.js"></script>
<script src="https://lemma.id/sdk/lemma-signin.js"></script>
<lemma-signin site-id="app.example.com"></lemma-signin>
<script>
  document.querySelector('lemma-signin').addEventListener('lemma-signin-success', (e) => {
    fetch('/api/login', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ presentation: e.detail.presentation }) });
  });
</script>
```

SDK directly (always pass `requiredAssurance` — `'passkey'` for login):

```javascript
const verifier = new ProofVerifier({ siteId: 'app.example.com' });
const { ok, presentation } = await verifier.verifyForBackend({
  autoProvision: true,
  requiredAssurance: 'passkey',
});
```

Backend: verify the presentation locally, find-or-create the user by
`result.ppid`, issue **your own** session cookie. Login returns `ppid` +
`assurance` only — no email/name/avatar; collect profile fields yourself on
first login.

## isHuman step-up (optional, same PPID)

Require one verified human per account for Sybil-sensitive actions (trials,
ticketing, payouts, post-ban recovery): set `requiredAssurance: 'ishuman'` on
both client and backend. The PPID does not change when a user upgrades tiers.

## Backend verifiers (local-first)

- npm: `npm install "@lemma.id/proof-verifier@1.4.0"` (quote on PowerShell); TypeScript types included
- Node/Workers: https://lemma.id/sdk/proof-verifier.mjs
- Python: https://lemma.id/sdk/proof-verifier.py
- PyPI: `pip install lemma-proof-verifier==1.4.0`
- Offline test helpers (no WebAuthn/lemma.id needed in CI):
  `@lemma.id/proof-verifier/testing` and `lemma_proof_verifier_testing.py`

## Browser SDK notes

- Create: `new ProofVerifier({ siteId: 'app.example.com' })`
- Compatibility: `ishuman-verifier.js` and `IsHumanVerifier` remain supported aliases
- Localhost dev works: `siteId` defaults to the page hostname; all localhost ports share the `localhost` binding

## Live demo

- https://lemma.id/demo

## Hard rules

1. `siteId` = canonical hostname (`app.example.com`), not internal `site_...` IDs.
2. Fail closed when `human` is false.
3. For signup/account creation and login, verify a signed `presentation` on the server, never trust a bare client `ppid`.
4. No customer webhooks, no wallet secret on the developer's backend, no KYC field storage.

## Out of scope for relying-site integration

Agent Ops (lemma-cli, Lemma Firewall, runtime control plane) is operator-only.
